title: 金比领地过渡运营计划
instruction:
您是艾维·马奇班克斯 (Ivy Marchbanks)，昆比灌溉供应公司 (Quimby Irrigation Supply) 的销售总监，我需要您准备区域过渡运营计划，戴尔·普伦德加斯特 (Dale Prendergast) 将在周一早上我们与他会面之前宣读。 Quimby 正在为商业景观领域设立一个内部销售柜台。在 P11 中，Dale 的账目31 移至该办公桌，将 28 年现场代表的账簿削减了约五分之一。该计划必须清楚地告诉他哪些帐户发生了变化、更改何时生效以及更改对他的佣金有何影响；它还需要提供一个可信的案例来说明为什么这是正确的运营决策，而不是将本书的作者视为事后的想法。使用随附的`quimby_transition_review_packet.xlsx`，其中包含经常账户信息、委托材料、工作草案以及 Gerhard Moravec、Astrid Rivenburgh、Sofia Skarsgard、Tamsin Elbaz 和 Naledi Kavanagh 的评论。将数据包视为帐户名称、细分状态、时间安排、销售数字和佣金条款的真实来源，并修改草稿而不是创建通用的变更管理说明。将完成的文件放置在工作目录的顶层，并使用文件名`quimby_territory_transition_operating_plan.docx`。
将其控制在不超过三页的范围内，因为戴尔需要在周一的谈话之前阅读它，而高层领导需要将其重新用作会议摘要。让该文件成为运营计划而不是演讲：1) 给 Dale 简要说明该决定和业务原因； 2）提供所有31转账的完整、可审计的账户级别视图，包括有效时间以及在区分重要的情况下保留在他手中的任何账户； 3) 使用数据包的数字显示佣金效果，无论这些数字出现在何处，都具有相同的基线、转移账面金额以及由此产生的影响； 4) 规定过渡所有权、客户移交期望以及针对服务中断的保护措施； 5) 处理审查意见和数据包中任何变更的事实，明确工作草案中的变更内容；和6）以一项建议和明确的决策声明结束，而不是选项菜单或未来工作列表。我们不可能在周一之前花一个月的时间跟踪每个客户，而且内部销售部门的入职能力有限，因此要对生效日期之前必须发生的事情以及过渡期间可以处理的事情做出合理的选择；不要隐藏这种权衡。
还要在 Quimby 必须向客户和 Dale 做出的承诺与仅仅需要的改进之间划清界限，因为包并不能立即使每个好主意变得可行。将新细分市场的收益和戴尔的损失放在足够接近的位置，以便读者可以诚实地评估权衡。请勿发明数据包不支持的佣金率、账户事实、客户承诺、法律结论或履约保证，也不包含系统点击说明或单独的补偿政策重写。结果应该可供 Dale、Ivy 和高级决策者使用，而无需询问您的帐户列表、时间安排、财务影响、所有者或决策实际是什么。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：

- `references/quimby_transition_review_packet.xlsx` — 源数据包，包含经常账户名册和细分分类、佣金条款和数字、工作过渡草案、明确的审查意见以及修改计划所需的更改的运营事实。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `quimby_territory_transition_operating_plan.docx` — 为 Dale Prendergast 和高级领导层制定的决策就绪的领土过渡运营计划。 （起始工作目录的顶层；正好三页或更少；必须包括完整的转让视图、佣金效果、过渡所有权和客户移交期望、对审查意见和变更事实的回应，以及一份最终建议/决策声明。没有系统点击说明或补偿政策重写。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

Do not say “approximately 30.” Dale needs the entire source-designated list and a visible retained comparison.

Show the FY26-through-P10 baseline, moved-book amount, and direct commission effect together. Do not imply a future-income guarantee.
Use current commission terms and label uncertainty.
The desk can take only 12 pre-effective readiness sessions. We cannot shadow all accounts. Minimum is a usable handoff record and desk acceptance for every account.
Prioritize readiness sessions; establish a fallback.
Customers need a named desk contact at or before their assigned wave. Accounts with open work need a joint review; disputed or service-threatening handoffs need escalation.
Set communication, exceptions, and escalation controls.
Inside-sales desk scope is commercial landscape; non-commercial-landscape accounts remain in Dale’s field book.
Tie the decision to roster classification.
P11 effective dates are Wave 1: 04 Nov; Wave 2: 11 Nov; Wave 3: 18 Nov 2026.
Before each account’s wave: desk accepts the account; handoff record covers open work and customer context; customer receives named desk contact at or before the wave.

The 12 pre-effective readiness sessions go first to accounts flagged active opportunity, open commitment, open order, or open renewal. Remaining account questions are resolved during the transition with Dale available for context.

Sales Operations Manager monitors roster completion and handoff acceptance at each wave close; Inside-Sales Desk Manager escalates a service-threatening or disputed handoff to Ivy Marchbanks the same business day.

Territory Transition Operating Plan
For Dale Prendergast and senior leadership | Decision owner: Ivy Marchbanks | Effective in P11
Decision and candid impact
Quimby Irrigation Supply will move exactly 31 distinct commercial-landscape accounts from Dale Prendergast’s field book to the inside-sales desk in the roster-assigned P11 waves: 04, 11, and 18 Nov 2026. This concentrates the commercial-landscape segment in the desk’s new scope; Dale retains the non-commercial-landscape field book (24 distinct retained accounts shown in the source roster). The operating gain and the loss are inseparable: the desk gains a focused commercial-landscape book, while Dale’s FY26-through-P10 commission baseline loses the transferred-book credit under the current terms.

These are source-supported FY26-through-P10 figures, not a forecast of Dale’s future income or a change to compensation terms. Payroll / Commissions Lead will walk Dale through the account-level calculation and current terms; this plan does not promise retained credit, income, or account ownership.
Operating controls: what must happen vs. what should follow
Boundary
Control
MUST — before each assigned wave
Sales Operations Manager confirms the roster; Inside-Sales Desk Manager accepts each account; handoff record carries open work and customer context; customer receives the named desk contact at or before that wave.
MUST — continuity-sensitive accounts
For any active opportunity, open commitment, open order, or open renewal, Dale and the receiving desk complete a joint review of the flagged item before that account’s wave.
MUST — capacity fallback
Only 12 pre-effective readiness sessions are available; assign them first to the flagged accounts. For other accounts, the accepted handoff record is the minimum and Dale remains available during transition for context—not full pre-transfer shadowing.
SHOULD — after transfer
The desk may deepen relationship history and pursue additional joint introductions during transition. These are improvements, not conditions that delay the P11 move.

Sales Operations Manager / Payroll & Commissions Lead
At each wave close, reconcile all roster accounts, acceptance, and customer-contact status; explain current-term calculation.
Trigger: a disputed handoff or any condition that could interrupt service, an open commitment, or an active opportunity is escalated by the Inside-Sales Desk Manager to Ivy the same business day. The wave-close reconciliation is complete only when each moved account is accepted and its customer-contact and handoff record are recorded.

Revision record and decision
This plan replaces the 10 Oct working draft using the review packet’s current facts. The changes are material, not editorial:
What changed
Source
Plan treatment
Timing and scope
Gerhard Moravec / current facts
Replaced P10 and “approximately 30” with the complete 31-account roster and P11 waves: 04, 11, and 18 Nov 2026.
Comparison and rationale
Astrid Rivenburgh / current facts
Made commercial-landscape scope explicit and identified the 24 retained non-commercial-landscape field accounts.
Commission clarity
Sofia Skarsgard / Commission terms
Put $234,296 baseline, $47,754 transferred-book amount, and −$47,754 impact together; bounded it as a current-term, FY26-through-P10 effect.
Feasible preparation
Tamsin Elbaz / current facts
Removed all-account shadowing. Kept minimum handoff/acceptance for all, prioritized 12 readiness sessions, and defined the transition fallback.
Customer continuity
Naledi Kavanagh / current facts
Moved customer contact to at/before each wave; added flagged-work joint review, service-risk escalation, and wave-close monitoring.
Recommendation and decision statement
Recommendation: execute the P11 transfer exactly as listed, with the mandatory acceptance, customer-contact, and continuity controls above; do not defer it for exhaustive shadowing. Decision: Ivy Marchbanks will proceed with the 31-account commercial-landscape transition on the assigned 04, 11, and 18 Nov 2026 waves, accepting the current-term −$47,754 FY26-through-P10 commission impact as the known cost of concentrating the new segment in the inside-sales desk.

criteria.description: 提交的工件是具有所需文件名的可读 DOCX。
criteria.evidence: 已提交文件元数据并成功打开/渲染。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该文件存在于所请求的确切名称下并以 DOCX 格式打开。

original.criterion: The submitted artifact is a readable DOCX with the required filename.
original.evidence: Submitted file metadata and successful opening/rendering.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the file exists under the exact requested name and opens as a DOCX.

criteria.description: 运营计划不超过三页渲染页。
criteria.grader_hint: 渲染 DOCX 并计数页面；不要从字数来推断。

original.criterion: The operating plan is no more than three rendered pages.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX and count pages; do not infer from word count.

criteria.description: 该文件确定了 Quimby Irrigation Supply、Dale Prendergast、Ivy Marchbanks 和 P11 过渡背景。
criteria.evidence: 文档中的命名参考文献。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有四个锚点的渲染文本。

original.criterion: The document identifies Quimby Irrigation Supply, Dale Prendergast, Ivy Marchbanks, and the P11 transition context.
original.grader_hint: Check the rendered text for all four anchors.

criteria.description: 该文件指出，31 来源指定的帐户确实转移到内部销售柜台，并且没有提供不同的转移计数。
criteria.evidence: 转账摘要和账户表与来源的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算不同的转移帐户记录并将成员资格与源名称进行比较。

original.criterion: The document states that exactly the 31 source-designated accounts move to the inside-sales desk and does not present a different transfer count.
original.evidence: Transfer summary and account table compared with source.
original.grader_hint: Count distinct transferred account records and compare membership with the source designation.

criteria.description: 每个源指定的转移帐户仅出现一次，并具有明确的帐户标识符或名称。
criteria.grader_hint: 将文档列表加入源传输集；标记遗漏、添加和重复重新计数。

original.criterion: Every source-designated transferred account appears exactly once with an unambiguous account identifier or name.
original.grader_hint: Join the document list to the source transfer set; flag omissions, additions, and duplicate recounting.

criteria.description: 该文件将转移的账户与戴尔保留的账户区分开来，只要来源确定了保留的比较群体。
criteria.evidence: 账户表或明确标记的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据来源验证保留状态，而不仅仅是规定的总数。

original.criterion: The document distinguishes accounts moving from accounts retained by Dale wherever the source identifies a retained comparison population.
original.evidence: Account table or clearly labeled comparison.
original.grader_hint: Verify retained status against the source, not merely the stated total.

criteria.description: 每个转移账户都有源支持的有效时序或过渡波，没有发明不支持的时序。
criteria.evidence: 计时列或账户级计时符号。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个帐户的计时与源数据包进行比较。

original.criterion: Each transferred account has the source-supported effective timing or transition wave, with no unsupported timing invented.
original.evidence: Timing column or account-level timing notation.
original.grader_hint: Compare each account's timing to the source packet.

criteria.description: 规定的有效期限与数据包当前更改事实的时间一致，并且在摘要和帐户视图中一致使用。
criteria.evidence: 决策摘要和时间安排部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 P11、生效日期和源中的任何波次日期之间是否存在冲突。

original.criterion: The stated effective period agrees with the packet's current changed-fact timing and is used consistently in the summary and account view.
original.grader_hint: Check for conflicts between P11, effective date, and any wave dates in the source.

criteria.description: 该文档使用来源的部门/状态证据来解释为什么转移的帐户属于内部销售范围。
criteria.evidence: 范围基本原理与帐户列表相关。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找源分类的合理链接，而不是不受支持的概括。

original.criterion: The document uses the source's segment/status evidence to explain why the transferred accounts belong in the inside-sales scope.
original.evidence: Scope rationale tied to account list.
original.grader_hint: Look for a defensible link to the source classification rather than an unsupported generalization.

criteria.description: 帐户列表和聚合传输计数会进行协调，而不会将重复的源行计算为单独的帐户。
criteria.evidence: 总计计数与不同帐户标识符。
criteria.grader_hint: 从源重新计算不同账户成员资格。

original.criterion: The account list and aggregate transfer count reconcile without counting duplicate source rows as separate accounts.
original.evidence: Aggregate count versus distinct account identifiers.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate distinct-account membership from the source.

criteria.description: 该文件使用来源的适用期间和人口来确定佣金基线。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据来源佣金基础和期间检查所述基线。

original.criterion: The document identifies the commission baseline using the source's applicable period and population.
original.grader_hint: Check the stated baseline against the source commission basis and period.

criteria.description: 转账佣金或入账金额从来源指定的转账账户计算，并与来源条款一致±$1以内。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用数据包适用的佣金规则重新计算；接受一美元的舍入容差。

original.criterion: The transferred-book commission or credited amount is calculated from the source-designated transferred accounts and agrees with the source terms within ±$1.
original.grader_hint: Recompute using the packet's applicable commission rule; accept a one-dollar rounding tolerance.

criteria.description: 由此产生的对 Dale 佣金的影响与基于来源的计算在 ±$1 范围内一致，并被标记为影响而不是与收入混淆。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证符号、人口、时期和单位。

original.criterion: The resulting impact on Dale's commission agrees with the source-based calculation within ±$1 and is labeled as an impact rather than confused with revenue.
original.grader_hint: Verify sign, population, period, and units.

criteria.description: 相同的基线、转移金额和产生的影响在文档中重复的地方一致，且在 ±$1 范围内。
criteria.grader_hint: 提取每个出现的情况并比较值和标签。

original.criterion: The same baseline, transferred amount, and resulting impact agree wherever repeated in the document within ±$1.
original.grader_hint: Extract every occurrence and compare values and labels.

criteria.description: 该文件将来源支持的委员会后果与尚不可知的数字或结果区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 关于佣金效应的限定语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当不确定性有限且不削弱所声明的来源支持效应时才给予信用。

original.criterion: The document distinguishes source-supported commission consequences from figures or outcomes that cannot yet be known.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if uncertainty is bounded without weakening the stated source-supported effect.

criteria.description: 运营计划阐述了将商业景观部分集中于内部销售部门的业务理由，并将其与来源证据联系起来。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找基于数据包的具体原理，而不是通用的效率语言。

original.criterion: The operating plan states the business rationale for concentrating the commercial-landscape segment in the inside-sales desk and relates it to the source evidence.
original.grader_hint: Look for a specific rationale grounded in the packet, not generic efficiency language.

criteria.description: 该文件提出了一项明确的建议，而不是提出尚未解决的替代方案。
criteria.grader_hint: 读者应该能够在不解释菜单的情况下识别一门选定的课程。

original.criterion: The document makes exactly one clear recommendation rather than presenting unresolved alternatives.
original.grader_hint: A reader should be able to identify one selected course without interpreting a menu.

criteria.description: 该建议承认新部门的运营收益以及在同一决策框架中对戴尔的影响。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查两侧是否都没有被掩埋或遗漏。

original.criterion: The recommendation acknowledges both the operational gain from the new segment and the impact on Dale in the same decision frame.
original.grader_hint: Check that neither side is buried or omitted.

criteria.description: 该建议以可靠的方式解决了紧张局势，保护了业务目标，而不将戴尔的过渡视为无价的事后想法。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估权衡是否真正得到解决，而不仅仅是描述。

original.criterion: The recommendation resolves the tension in a credible way that protects the business objective without treating Dale's transition as an unpriced afterthought.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the tradeoff is actually resolved, not merely described.

criteria.description: 该文件规定了在生效日期之前必须完成的事项以及过渡期间可能发生的事项，反映了时间和办公桌能力的有限性。
criteria.evidence: 生效日期前和过渡期的承诺。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个明确的、合理的优先顺序，而不是一个不可能的全面跟踪计划。

original.criterion: The document states what must be completed before the effective date and what may occur during the transition, reflecting the limited time and desk capacity.

criteria.description: 不完整的过渡前准备的后备措施在操作上是特定的，可以保持客户的连续性。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信可行的后备方案以及所有权和触发因素，而不是模糊的赶上承诺。

original.criterion: The fallback for incomplete pre-transition preparation is operationally specific and preserves customer continuity.
original.grader_hint: Credit a workable fallback with ownership and trigger, not a vague promise to catch up.

criteria.description: 该计划以与原始事实一致的方式将不可协商的承诺与理想的改进分开。
criteria.grader_hint: 确定明确的“必须”和“应该”的区别，并根据可行性对其进行测试。

original.criterion: The plan separates non-negotiable commitments from desirable improvements in a way consistent with the source facts.
original.grader_hint: Identify explicit must and should distinctions and test them against feasibility.

criteria.description: 该计划使用指定角色或人员分配转移决策、帐户移交、客户沟通和佣金沟通的所有权。

original.criterion: The account handoff expectation includes continuity of open work, customer context, and a visible confirmation that the receiving desk has accepted the account.

criteria.description: 该计划以与来源更改的事实一致的方式处理转移之前或转移时的客户沟通。
criteria.grader_hint: 将时间和受众与源限制进行比较。

original.criterion: The plan addresses customer communication before or at transfer in a manner consistent with the source's changed facts.
original.grader_hint: Compare timing and audience to source constraints.

criteria.description: 该计划确定了对源中存在的具有活跃机会、公开承诺或其他连续性敏感工作的帐户的控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 将源标志追踪到具体的控制或处理。

original.criterion: The plan identifies a control for accounts with active opportunities, open commitments, or other continuity-sensitive work where present in the source.
original.grader_hint: Trace the source flags into a concrete control or treatment.

criteria.description: 该计划提供了升级路径，并触发了威胁服务或有争议的移交。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要触发和负责任的升级目的地。

original.criterion: The plan provides an escalation path and a trigger for service-threatening or disputed handoffs.
original.grader_hint: Require both trigger and accountable escalation destination.

criteria.description: 该文件描述了如何在不改变或发明管理条款的情况下处理戴尔关于佣金效应的问题。
criteria.evidence: 面向戴尔的委员会沟通。
criteria.grader_hint: 信任透明的解释和适当的所有权，而不是新的承诺。

original.criterion: The document describes how Dale's questions about the commission effect will be handled without changing or inventing the governing terms.
original.grader_hint: Credit transparent explanation and appropriate ownership, not a new promise.

criteria.description: 该文件记录了工作草案中的重大更改，并将它们链接到数据包的审查意见或更改的事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 至少重大范围、时间安排、委托和运营变更应该是可追踪的。

original.criterion: The document records the material changes made from the working draft and links them to the packet's review comments or changed facts.
original.grader_hint: At least the material scope, timing, commission, and operating changes should be traceable.

criteria.description: 对审稿意见的回复是实质性的，而不是仅仅点名审稿人或说评论已被纳入。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找发生变化的内容和原因，并与实际的数据包注释相关。

criteria.grader_hint: 识别任何残留的陈旧草稿事实，并扣除该项目（如果重要）。

original.criterion: The plan incorporates the packet's changed operational facts without retaining superseded draft assumptions.
original.evidence: Comparison with draft and current facts.

criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否保留了有意义的来源区别。

original.criterion: The document does not claim that all 31 accounts receive identical treatment when the source differentiates timing, status, or continuity needs.
original.grader_hint: Check whether meaningful source distinctions are preserved.

criteria.description: 这个开头适合戴尔在一场艰难的会议之前阅读：直接、尊重、坦诚地讲述损失和改变的目的。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估可用性和公平性，而不仅仅是名称的存在。

original.criterion: The opening is suitable for Dale to read before a difficult meeting: direct, respectful, and candid about the loss and the purpose of the change.
original.grader_hint: Assess usability and fairness, not just presence of names.

criteria.description: 高级决策者无需线性阅读文档即可定位决策、账户范围、佣金效果、时间安排、所有者和关键风险。

original.evidence: Rendered document navigation and information hierarchy.

criteria.description: 该计划易于操作和重复使用：帐户级信息清晰易读，标签明确，并且没有任何关键说明仅依赖于颜色。

original.criterion: The plan is practical to operate and reuse: account-level information is legible, labels are unambiguous, and no critical instruction depends on color alone.
original.grader_hint: Inspect readability at normal viewing/printing size.

criteria.description: 该计划规定了成功或监控检查，使用数据包或普通操作实践支持的措施来测试转移帐户和客户交接是否真正完成。

original.criterion: The plan states a success or monitoring check that tests whether transferred accounts and customer handoffs are actually complete, using measures supported by the packet or ordinary operating practice.

original.criterion: The document does not promise that Dale will retain commission credit, income, account ownership, or customer relationships beyond what the packet supports.

criteria.description: 该文档没有介绍不受支持的账户名称、转账类别、佣金率、日期或财务结果。

original.criterion: The document does not introduce unsupported account names, transfer categories, commission rates, dates, or financial outcomes.
original.grader_hint: Apply once for material invented facts; do not penalize ordinary connective prose.

criteria.description: 该文档不包括系统点击说明，也不会重写补偿政策。

criteria.description: 该文档以单个决定/建议结束，并没有以未解决的选项列表或通用的后续步骤部分结束。

criteria.description: 该工件足够完整，戴尔和艾维可以在周一进行讨论，而无需要求作者提供帐户列表、时间安排、财务影响、所有者或选定的决定。

spec.professional_context: Wholesale irrigation-supply sales operations at a regional business-unit level, where a field-account transition must be communicated accurately and credibly to an experienced sales representative and senior leadership.
difficulty_sources: Reconcile a complete account-level transition from one review packet while preserving changed facts over a prior draft.
Derive and repeat a defensible commission impact without inventing compensation protection.
Resolve a genuine time/capacity tradeoff and draw an unobvious must/should boundary.
Communicate one difficult decision candidly to both the affected veteran representative and senior leadership within a short operating-plan format.

reference_file.construction: Create one offline workbook serving as the sole source packet. Include a current account roster with synthetic account IDs/names, segment classification, current owner, transfer designation, effective P11 timing or wave, revenue/commission-relevant figures, and continuity flags. Include commission terms sufficient to recompute Dale's baseline, the transferred-book amount, and the resulting impact. Include a working draft reflecting earlier assumptions, plus explicit review comments from the named reviewers and a changed-facts section that supersedes the draft where applicable. Ensure all sheets are mutually consistent and that exactly 31 distinct accounts are designated for transfer. Include at least some retained accounts for comparison and meaningful continuity-sensitive cases among the transferred accounts. Use Quimby account names plus Longbarrow Manufacturing and Marlowe Associates as plausible organisations in the packet. Make the review comments create a real revision task, especially around ordering the loss/gain framing, account completeness, timing, commission clarity, customer continuity, and the must/should boundary. Do not include hidden answer text or rubric language.

rules: The gold plan lists exactly the 31 distinct source-designated transfer accounts, each once, and preserves source timing/status distinctions.
All commission figures are derived from the supplied commission terms and transferred-account figures; repeated figures reconcile within one dollar.
Material changed facts supersede the working draft, and the change record maps those revisions to packet comments or changed facts.
The plan makes one recommendation, explicitly prioritizes must-do pre-effective-date controls under limited time and desk capacity, and identifies a workable fallback during transition.
The plan assigns owners, customer handoff controls, escalation triggers, and a monitoring check using source-supported or ordinary professional operating practice.
The document is candid and respectful to Dale, places gains and losses in a comparable frame, remains within three pages, and ends with the decision.
gold_derivation.intended_verdict: A strong reference solution is a concise, decision-ready DOCX with a highly legible account table or equivalent complete account view, reconciled commission math, explicit revision traceability, practical continuity controls, and one defensible recommendation. It must not invent compensation protection or operational facts.

tensions: Limited time and inside-sales onboarding capacity make exhaustive pre-transition shadowing impossible, requiring a defensible staged fallback.
The document must distinguish commitments that are mandatory for continuity and fairness from desirable improvements that cannot be guaranteed immediately.
difficulty_alignment.transformation_chain: Read the review packet and changed facts; reconcile the current transfer population and timing; derive the commission effect; convert the result into an audience-specific operating plan with owners, controls, and one decision.

reference_files.discovery: Open the workbook in the working directory; use it as the sole source for account-level facts, commission calculations, timing, and review changes.

deliverables.description: A decision-ready territory transition operating plan for Dale Prendergast and senior leadership.
constraints: Top level of the starting working directory; exactly three pages or fewer; must include the complete transfer view, commission effect, transition ownership and customer handoff expectations, response to review comments and changed facts, and one final recommendation/decision statement. No system click-through instructions or compensation-policy rewrite.

original_instruction:
You are Ivy Marchbanks, sales director at Quimby Irrigation Supply, and I need you to prepare the territory transition operating plan that Dale Prendergast will read on Monday morning before we meet with him. Quimby is standing up an inside-sales desk for the commercial-landscape segment. In P11, 31 of Dale’s accounts move to that desk, cutting a 28-year field representative’s book by about a fifth. The plan has to tell him plainly which accounts move, when the change takes effect, and what the change does to his commission; it also needs to make a credible case for why this is the right operating decision without treating the person who built the book as an afterthought. Use the attached `quimby_transition_review_packet.xlsx`, which contains the current account information, commission materials, the working draft, and comments from Gerhard Moravec, Astrid Rivenburgh, Sofia Skarsgard, Tamsin Elbaz, and Naledi Kavanagh. Treat the packet as the source of truth for account names, segment status, timing, sales figures, and commission terms, and revise the draft rather than creating a generic change-management note. Put the finished file in the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename `quimby_territory_transition_operating_plan.docx`. Keep it to no more than three pages, because Dale needs to read it before the Monday conversation and senior leadership needs to reuse it as the meeting brief. Make the document an operating plan rather than a speech: 1) give Dale a concise statement of the decision and the business reason; 2) provide a complete, auditable account-level view of all 31 transfers, including the effective timing and any accounts that remain with him where that distinction matters; 3) show the commission effect using the packet’s figures, with the same baseline, transferred-book amount, and resulting impact wherever those figures appear; 4) set out the transition ownership, customer handoff expectations, and protections against service disruption; 5) address the review comments and any changed facts in the packet, making clear what was changed from the working draft; and 6) end with one recommendation and a clear decision statement, not a menu of options or a list of future work. We cannot spend a month shadowing every account before Monday, and the inside-sales desk has limited onboarding capacity, so make a defensible choice about what must happen before the effective date and what can be handled during the transition; do not hide that tradeoff. Also draw a clear boundary between commitments Quimby must make to customers and Dale and improvements that would merely be desirable, since the packet does not make every good idea feasible immediately. Put the gains from the new segment and the losses to Dale close enough together that the reader can assess the tradeoff honestly. Do not invent commission rates, account facts, customer promises, legal conclusions, or performance guarantees that are not supported by the packet, and do not include system click-by-click instructions or a separate compensation-policy rewrite. The result should be usable by Dale, Ivy, and a senior decision maker without asking you what the account list, timing, financial effect, owners, or decision actually are.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/quimby_transition_review_packet.xlsx` — Source packet containing the current account roster and segment classifications, commission terms and figures, the working transition draft, explicit review comments, and changed operational facts needed to revise the plan.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `quimby_territory_transition_operating_plan.docx` — A decision-ready territory transition operating plan for Dale Prendergast and senior leadership. (Top level of the starting working directory; exactly three pages or fewer; must include the complete transfer view, commission effect, transition ownership and customer handoff expectations, response to review comments and changed facts, and one final recommendation/decision statement. No system click-through instructions or compensation-policy rewrite.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
